checkRuns.command:
pkill -f "next" ; sed -i 's/^export function generateStaticParams/export const dynamicParams = false;\n\nexport function generateStaticParams/' app/books/\[slug\]/page.tsx
bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i -E "error|fail"; 
PORT=4711 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4711 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &
sleep 4
curl -s -o /tmp/o -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4711/books/nope; grep -o "<title>[^<]*\|<h1>[^<]*" /tmp/o
curl -s localhost:4711/contact | grep -o '<input type="hidden"[^>]*>' | head

grep -c dynamicParams app/books/\[slug\]/page.tsx; bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i -E "error|fail"; 
(PORT=4711 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4711 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
curl -s -o /tmp/o -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4711/books/nope; grep -o "<title>[^<]*\|<h1>[^<]*" /tmp/o
curl -s localhost:4711/contact | grep -o '<input type="hidden"[^>]*>' | head -3

pkill -f "next-server|next start"; sed -i 's/^export function generateStaticParams/export const dynamicParams = false;\n\nexport function generateStaticParams/' app/books/\[slug\]/page.tsx
grep -c dynamicParams app/books/\[slug\]/page.tsx; bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i -E "error|fail|dynamicParams"
(PORT=4711 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4711 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
curl -s -o /tmp/o -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4711/books/nope; grep -o "<title>[^<]*\|<h1>[^<]*" /tmp/o
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4711/books/dracula

sed -i 's/^export function generateStaticParams/export const dynamicParams = false;\n\nexport function generateStaticParams/' app/books/\[slug\]/page.tsx
grep -c dynamicParams app/books/\[slug\]/page.tsx; bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i -E "error|fail"
(PORT=4711 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4711 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
curl -s -o /tmp/o -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4711/books/nope; grep -o "<title>[^<]*\|<h1>[^<]*" /tmp/o
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4711/books/dracula
